messages:
michael (support): hey all — input from support: starting ~06:48 multiple customers reported errors & latency hitting the embeddings endpoint in eu-west-1. common message: embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 but got 512. customers are not receiving embeddings for batch requests. sample errors attached.

michael (support): sample curl that failed:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model": "embed-large-2025", "input": ["a","b","c"]}'
```

michael (support): response 422 JSON below:
```json
{"error":"embedding service: vector size mismatch, expected 1536, found 512","request_id":"req_9bcd"}
```

elena (oncall): ack. i'm oncall, looking. @javier can you check autoscaler / recent infra deploys? nora can you pull metrics on queue times and worker restarts?

javier (infra): checking k8s events and autoscaler in eu-west-1. no recent node pool changes. there's a canary of model-routing-service rolled out 06:40 to 10% traffic. i'm pulling logs now.

nora (sre): alerting: embedding_error_rate p95 spiked from 0.2% to 9.7% across the cluster starting 06:48. latency p90 doubled. seeing many 422s with error 'vector length mismatch'.

samir (ml-eng): quick hypothesis: we onboarded a quantized small-variant 'embed-large-quantized-v2' (512 dims) and the model-catalog metadata wasn't updated in the routing layer. routing may be serving the 512-dim model to requests that expect 1536. checking model catalog commits at 06:35.

samir (ml-eng): found commit that renamed variant id from 'embed-large-v2' to 'embed-large-quantized-v2' but left the advertised dimension at 1536 in the control plane. if routing matches by variant id, a mismatch can happen when fallback routing picks the quantized model.

elena (oncall): can we reproduce locally? samir, can you craft a request that forces the quantized variant and confirm dims?

samir (ml-eng): repro steps:
1) hit internal routing API: POST /internal/route with model_hint 'embed-large' and prefer_quantized:true
2) then call embeddings endpoint with same request id
example:
```bash
# step 1
curl -X POST https://internal-router/eu-west-1/route -d '{"model_hint":"embed-large","prefer_quantized":true}'
# step 2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["x"]}'
```
observed: route returned variant embed-large-quantized-v2 (512) and embeddings endpoint failed with expected 1536.

javier (infra): looks like routing-service has a cache TTL of 5m that didn't pick up the metadata correction. can rollback the route change or temporarily disable prefer_quantized default. i'm going to toggle prefer_quantized to false in the feature flag for eu-west-1.

elena (oncall): do it. set maintenance page? any customer facing mitigation first?

michael (support): I'll add note to status page and message affected customers we've got a mitigation in progress. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0457 | severity: major | affected: embeddings (eu-west-1) | created_by: michael (support)

javier (infra): feature flag toggled at 07:10. routing-service now prefers stable variants. monitoring shows error rate dropping.

nora (sre): error rate down to 1.1% within 6 minutes; latency p90 trending back towards normal. no full outage, partial degradation.

samir (ml-eng): confirmed: after disabling prefer_quantized, requests are routed to embed-large-stable (1536) and errors stop. root cause: metadata inconsistency + canary routing policy. we also lacked an enforcement check that verifies model dim advertised by catalog matches runtime variant.

elena (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. next steps: rollback canary for quantized variant until model-catalog metadata validated, add pre-deploy hook to assert dims, add metric to alert when returned vector length doesn't match catalog. samir please file a follow-up ticket.

samir (ml-eng): will open RFC + ticket: EMB-1234 with repro, suggested tests, and rollout plan. propose a temporary alert where >1% of embeddings return wrong length for >2min.

michael (support): customers updated and support queue cleared for the affected tickets. leaving this thread for a short postmortem. thanks team :heart:

elena (oncall): incident resolved. closing after postmortem. timeline + link to postmortem will be posted here.
